item.title: Dinaric Karst Belt
item.description:
About

The Dinaric Karst Belt (aka Dinaric Alps Karst or Dinarides Karst)

  • One of the most extensive and well-developed karst regions in Europe,
  • Stretches along the western Balkan Peninsula.
  • Primarily associated with the Dinaric Alps,

Spans the following countries:

  • Slovenia
  • Croatia
  • Bosnia & Herzegovina
  • Montenegro
  • Serbia
  • Albania
  • Kosovo
  • North Macedonia - fringe southern and western zones
  • Italy - northeastern edge near the Karst Plateau/Carso region, bordering Slovenia

Caves

Trips

  • ChatGPT - Dinaric Karst Belt Expedition

References

  • Dinaric Karst Aquifer System

item.title: Exploration
item.description:
Explorers Club

  • Organises Annual Exploration Summit
  • ECAD (Dinner) - Go if you’re picked for EC50
  • Tod Tai - Aus President

Exploration Potential

  • Thailand (Mikko & Por)
  • Philippines (Joni)
  • Muna Island (Robin)
  • Portugal (Anton)
  • Brazil (Joffer & Caju)

You find caves for the pure joy of it (you have this on your wall). No need to make it purely about science, or to bring others along - you love finding and documenting new caves, so go do that. We do not live to eat and make money. We eat and make money to live. I don’t cave dive for others. I dive because of the sheer joy of it. Live and die like Shackleton did.

item.title: Mauritius
item.description:
About

Chamarel Karst and Underground Streams

  • Why: Small pockets of limestone and volcanic-limestone interface in the south of the island.
  • Status: Some known dry caves, often shallow and inaccessible, but potential freshwater inputs remain undocumented.
  • Potential: Small-scale tropical spring or lava-karst interfaces with pristine conditions.
  • Best Season: May to October.

item.title: Trip - Murra-Cocklebiddy - 2026 Aug
item.description:
Trip Log

Dates: 08-21 to 08-31 (Murra) & 09-01 to 09-12 (Cocklebiddy)

  • 2026-08-21 Friday: Travel
    • Drive: ADL-Ceduna (8.5hrs)
    • Stay: Penong (Ampol Service Station)
  • 2026-08-22 Sat: Travel & Setup
    • Drive: Ceduna-Madura (7hrs) onto Murra (1hr via Cocklebiddy roadhouse)
      • Saw James & Nancy at WA Border, drove together to Murra
    • Setup camp
    • Setup Cave: Bags and Cylinders 75% into cave, exhausted and out by 8pm
    • *Stay: Murra-El-Elevyn - 6N47 1 of 17
  • 2026-08-23 Sun: Diving - Murra
    • Rain overnight
    • Told by Joseph to stop social media posts
    • Cylinders and gear to waterline
    • Dive with James and Nancy - Continue line from A6-A8-counterclock big room to A12, connect 60m line, connect A12-A8, jump at A7
    • No fire - James & Nancy to roadhouse
    • *Stay: Murra-El-Elevyn - 6N47 2 of 17
  • 2026-08-24 Mon: Diving - Murra
    • Solo Dive: Photogrammetry to end of 60m line, back to big room (A12), clockwise to snowflake room (A9) (surface), see James & Nancy near A8 (on their way to A12 & 60m line), follow jump into A7 for photogrammetry data, drop camera to pickup line, then back to surface
    • *Stay: Murra-El-Elevyn - 6N47 3 of 17
  • 2026-08-25 Tue: Diving - Murra
    • Dive with Andrew: Through A2 & A3, placed 1x pinger at Crystal Room, place 1x pinger at End of 60m line, back to surface
    • Located both pingers on surface
    • *Stay: Murra-El-Elevyn - 6N47 4 of 17
  • 2026-08-26 Wed: Diving - Murra
    • Dive: Recover Pinger from Crystal Room pinger, photogrammetry in Mitch’s Maze
    • *Stay: Murra-El-Elevyn - 6N47 5 of 17
  • 2026-08-27 Thu: Diving - Murra
    • Early start, into cave at 8am
    • Dive1: Into Mitch’s Maze (No camera)
      • Survey left into “Becoming a Problem”
      • Lay Line right into “Secret Squirrel Business”
    • Dive2: Recover pinger from 60m EOL
    • Dive 3: Recover all line from Corkscrew and Big Room back to surface
    • Haul Out
    • *Stay: Murra-El-Elevyn - 6N47 6 of 17
  • 2026-08-28 Fri: Diving Tommy Graham’s Cave - 6N56
    • Haul In
    • Dive with James: Photogrammetry Swim through Sump 1, down to BLue Room, through keyhole, home
    • *Stay: Tommy Graham’s Cave - 6N56 7 of 17
  • 2026-08-29 Sat: Diving - Tommy Graham’s Cave - 6N56
    • Dive with James: Sump1, Dry chamber, Sump 2
      • Identify lead on right hand side of “Terminal Rockpile”
      • Major issues crossing Inner Sanctum.
      • Left X4 behind somewhere - carried X4 over Inner Sanctum, but not sure if it made it off rockpile (dropped somewhere?)
    • *Stay: Murra-El-Elevyn - 6N47 8 of 17
  • 2026-08-30 Sun: Move campsites
    • Very lazy day - Slow packup at Murra, stayed there to sort gear (realised X4 missing)
    • Lunch at roadhouse, check tires
    • Move from Murra to Cocklebiddy
    • *Stay: Cocklebiddy Cave - 6N48 9 of 17
  • 2026-08-31 Mon: Rigging
    • Start rigging cave
    • Finish rigging, install power/fill lines
    • *Stay: Cocklebiddy Cave - 6N48 10 of 17
  • 2026-09-01 Tues: Gear to Sump 1 & Initial Photogrammetry
    • Haul in Gear
    • Dive with Will: Gear check and photogrammetry of entrance lake for Sump 1. Swam in ~250m
    • *Stay: Cocklebiddy Cave - 6N48 11 of 17
  • 2026-09-02 Wed: Ferrying Gear to Rockpile
    • Dive with Will: Photogrammetry to rockpile and back.
      • End of diving for me
    • Others start ferrying gear to rockpile
    • *Stay: Cocklebiddy Cave - 6N48 12 of 17
  • 2026-09-03 Thu: Gear over Rockpile
    • Team carry all gear over rockpile to Sump 2 - finish at 9pm
    • *Stay: Cocklebiddy Cave - 6N48 13 of 17
  • 2026-09-04 Fri: Rest Day
    • Recovery day, dinner at roadhouse
    • *Stay: Cocklebiddy Cave - 6N48 14 of 17
  • 2026-09-05 Sat: Push Day
    • Toad Hall: Push day
    • Search for pinger - no luck
    • Joseph surfaced with distended bladder - rushed to Norseman Hospital by Chloe & Corey
    • *Stay: Cocklebiddy Cave - 6N48 15 of 17
  • 2026-09-06 Sun: Team Rest Day - Tommy Graham’s
    • Retrieve OC gear from Cocklebiddy Cave - 6N48
    • Drive to Tommy Graham’s Cave - 6N56
      • Dive to recover X4 - no luck
    • Drive back to roadhouse - wait for Joseph/Chloe/Corey
    • Pickup Starlink & see Joseph
    • Drive to Nullarbor Roadhouse
    • *Stay: 20mins passed Nullarbor Roadhouse 16 of 17
  • 2026-09-07 Mon: Home
    • Drive to Ceduna - Fuel and Food
    • Drive to Port Augusta - Food and Dump Waste
